english.note: Use this specifically when repose means sleep, not for a general break or rest.

exampleSentences.english: I need some repose tonight, so I am going to bed early because I have an early shift tomorrow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我今晚要早啲瞓覺，聽朝仲要返早更。
